title.narrative: UNICEF maintained its support for improving access to water, sanitation, and hygiene services. As a result, at least 129,728 people discontinued open defecation, with an additional 105,846 people benefiting from a sanitation marketing approach. Furthermore, 81,908 people gained access to sustainable water sources and 47,784 flood-affected people received WASH assistance.
